posts.text: Co-sign. The only future that is worth building is one in which AI remains a tool in human hands, used to elevate the human condition.
posts.quoted: People should always be in control of the future. OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”. People should not cede control of the future to
